title: {{NAME}} and the Superhero Animals' Championship
moral: Believing in yourself gives you the courage to try.

pages.content: {{NAME}} arrived at the biggest soccer stadium ever. It sparkled with lights. Animals in superhero capes filled the seats. On the field, a team of super animals was warming up. A tiger in a red cape, a dolphin in a blue cape, and a bear in a purple cape. {{NAME}} was going to play with them.
